text: Where does this polygon belong?
A vertex is a corner where two sides meet.
A side is a straight line joining two vertices.
An angle is formed where two sides meet.
A diagonal joins two non-adjacent vertices.
In a convex polygon, all diagonals stay inside.
In a concave polygon, atleast one diagonal goes outside.
A regular polygon has all sides and all angles equal.
If the sides or angles are not all equal, the polygon is irregular.
